title: Workload shape → reservation recommendation (rolling 12-week mapping)
summary: Rolling 12-week mapping from observed workload shape (qps distribution + sequence length percentiles) to reservation recommendation. Purpose: feed Optimize tooling with a conservative baseline and 2 alternate plans (aggressive save, safety-first). Working numbers; intended for product + finance review.
assumptions: median seq length used for baseline throughput conversion; P95 used for peak reservation sizing
effective throughput per A100-80GB GPU for target model family = 220 effective tokens/sec for median sequences
burst tolerance handled by buffer (non-reserved) for short spikes under 5 minutes
reservation sizing rounding to nearest 2 GPUs for pool simplicity
cost model excludes network/egress; focuses on GPU-hour delta between reserved vs on-demand

analysis_notes: Calculation summary: est_tokens_needed_p95 = p95_qps * p95_seq_len * 60 (tokens per minute) ; converted to tokens/sec and divided by tokens_per_sec_per_gpu to estimate GPUs. Final GPU numbers rounded to nearest 2; reservation recommendation chooses a conservative floor between 85%-95% of peak GPUs depending on buffer policy.
Observations: weekly peaks vary >2x; short bursts (under 10m) cause nominal GPU churn — recommend short-term burst pool (on-demand) rather than over-reserving.
Cost sensitivity: moving 6 GPUs from on-demand to reserved yields ~12-15% monthly GPU cost savings for those hours; but reserve mis-sizing during holiday dips increases wasted committed hours cost.
Policy options encoded: 'safety-first' (+10% headroom), 'balanced' (+6% headroom), 'aggressive-save' (+0–3% headroom with automated fallback).
recommendation: Adopt a two-tier reservation plan: 1) baseline reserved pool sized to the 70th–75th percentile of weekly P95 GPU requirements (rounded to 2 GPUs) to capture steady savings; 2) a small committed burst pool (3–6 GPUs) for predictable scheduled spikes (marketing events). For major promos (holiday weeks), opt for temporary extra reservation with finance sign-off. Default policy = 'balanced' (6% headroom).
